intro.text: Pilot: “Good morning Seattle Radio. Cessna One Three Two Four calling on One Two Two Point Two.” Specialist: “Cessna One Three Two Four, Seattle Radio. Go ahead.” Pilot: “I need to activate my VFR flight plan off of KSEA at this time.” Specialist: “November Three Two Four. I have your flight plan activated at this time. There are no adverse conditions along your route of flight, pilot reports appreciated, and for additional en-route weather, contact Flight Watch One Two Two Point Zero.” True or False: The Specialist responded in the appropriate Radio Message Format.
